title: PTP: add dissection of L1Sync frames (defined in IEEE1588-2019, Annex L)

notes.body: .itc (and not .irc )
good catch!
why don't display the first 2 bytes and after optional 3th bytes ?

Do you mean something like:

![image](/uploads/44fae036ff6fd96004d8746cd7328c97/image.png)

I don't like this solution because in the standard "flags ext" are not distinguished from "flags". Another idea was to have "flags1", "flags2", "flags3". Then "flags3" is displayed only when the frame contains it.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/11863/diffs?diff_id=772671685&start_sha=1fbf72d3a2b82cd428edb40aefb7f03adac7d83e#c44b9cae397bb1b76ce465b29a7f38d6c27973f7_6954_6956)

you can also use flags1,flags2 and flags3 options

@martin.r.mathieson a better idea ?

Another idea is to have:
```
flags (ptp.v2.sig.tlv.l1sync.flags)
   optParamsEnabled (ptp.v2.sig.tlv.l1sync.flags.ope)
   ...
flags ext (ptp.v2.sig.tlv.l1sync.flags_ext)   <-- I have to use flags_ext here, otherwise there is a warning 
   frequencyOffsetTxValid (ptp.v2.sig.tlv.l1sync.flags.fov)   <-- but here I could use "flags" not "flags_ext" for the filtering id
```

let me know which solution is the preferred one
@martin.r.mathieson @alagoutte I pushed the code to implement solution from my last comment. Let me know if you agree on such solution or have another idea
I think you'd need to duplicate the fields if you really want them to come out with right number of bits.

@martin.r.mathieson thanks a lot. I added duplicates. Now flags field is as intended.

2 bytes (basic format):

![image](/uploads/3223921fb79e160150434d027e5c360f/image.png)

3 bytes (extended format):

![image](/uploads/da21245e1372ac3f0002df7bb8be3d3b/image.png)
I known, it is already merge but can be nice(recommended) to display unused/reserved bits

There are more reserved bits (14) in the flags field than used (10). With added reserved bits it would look like:

![image](/uploads/4829ba7318205122b0863432de191bcd/image.png)

Or is it preferred to use only one reserved field?

![image](/uploads/3f8f43cc46e8375701acf80d20d51388/image.png)
I'd say whatever you prefer Adam.
i prefer solution 2
with "reserved" at the end or in different location? IMHO: at the end, as in the second picture
at the end
Added in !11946

Can you check this warning :

`Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-ptp.c:3813 proto_tree_add_uint called for hf_ptp_v2_fu_preciseorigintimestamp_32bit  -  item type is FT_UINT32 but call has len 10`
Solved. Please check if you accept it. I used proto_tree_add_bytes_format_value with FT_BYTES instead of proto_tree_add_uint64 with FT_UINT32.
